name: Scissorhands: Exploiting the Persistence of Importance Hypothesis for LLM KV Cache Compression at Test Time
problem: The KV cache can exceed the model weights themselves and caps inference batch size; existing compression needed fine-tuning or degraded quality.
mechanism: The PERSISTENCE OF IMPORTANCE hypothesis: a token that had substantial influence at one decoding step will continue to influence future generations, so influence is predictable from past attention scores. Scissorhands maintains a fixed KV memory budget WITHOUT finetuning by storing PIVOTAL tokens with a higher probability - a Metropolis-style stochastic retention rule rather than a hard top-k - so the budget is respected while pivotal tokens survive.
speedup_reported: Paper's own claims (abstract): reduces inference KV-cache memory by UP TO 5x without compromising model quality; and when COMBINED WITH 4-bit quantization (which is for weights, not the cache) achieves up to 20x compression. The 5x is the standalone KV claim; the 20x only exists in combination with weight quantization, so quoting 20x as the KV-cache result would misrepresent the paper.
